notes: V36 (CR 601.2f, 601.2h: unpayable costs can't be paid): with an empty hand, the Sparkhunter Masticore exiled by Idol of Endurance cannot be cast, because its additional cost (discard a card) cannot be paid, so the menu does not offer it and it stays in exile; the Idol's activation still resolves (it taps). Ontology round R13: the activation makes a PERMIT; the cast is a menu row through it (cast:<card>:via:<idol>).
